authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner dugdha explicitly includes Oriya dud breast, western Pahari dudhu female breast/breast-milk and Jaunsari dudhū teat. These regional dud(h) breast responses therefore fit an attested milk-to-breast extension, with local deaspiration, devoicing and nominal endings preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner asmad explicitly groups the western ame/āmhī, central ham, northwestern as/assī and Khowar ispā pronouns, deriving their modern paradigms from Middle Indo-Aryan nominative, oblique and instrumental forms. The selected survey pronouns fit these regional families, including contracted spā and western am(u) variants. Inclusive/exclusive labels are retained as elicited, not projected onto the ancestor.
